subject: CRITICAL: API returning 500 on /v1/checkout/charge
body:
Hi Support Team,

Our production app is completely unable to process payments. We are receiving 500 Internal Server Error responses on every call to POST https://api.service.com/v1/checkout/charge.

Trace ID: tr_99214_prod
SDK: mermail-node-v3.4.1
Time: 10:15 AM EST
Authorization: Bearer sec_tok_live_89123849182390123

This is blocking all user transactions. Please help urgently!

Best,
